name: Belaxis
description: A talkative half-compleated aspirant bound by contract to Geth, who guards his gate and helps Ixhel; she later sacrifices him on the Dominus of Pain.

timeline.summary: Ixhel pins a stammering aspirant who says he is Belaxis and has a contract with Lord Geth, whom he calls the Thane of Contracts.
timeline.quote: Lord Geth makes deals. That's why they call him the Thane of Contracts!

timeline.summary: Belaxis helps Ixhel crack the sound puzzle to open the gate and she gives him her name.
timeline.quote: The door flashes with a thin blue light, and the gate grinds open.

timeline.summary: Ixhel impales Belaxis on a spike of the Dominus of Pain, saying she is grateful.
timeline.quote: A piercing wail rings out across the wastes as you pin the writhing body in your arms down onto a razor-tipped spoke

relations.note: Ixhel impales Belaxis on the Dominus.
